home.heroSubtitle: Bringing together French-Bangladeshi journalists around professionalism, training and solidarity.

faq.q: Who can become a member of FBJA?
faq.a: Any French-Bangladeshi journalist or media professional based in France can apply for membership.

faq.q: How do I join the association?
faq.a: Fill out the form on the Membership page. Our board reviews each application within two weeks.

about.intro: FBJA brings together French-Bangladeshi journalists in France to defend professionalism, press freedom, and solidarity among peers.
about.missionBody: Support Bangladeshi and French-Bangladeshi journalists in France through training, mutual aid, and professional representation.
about.visionBody: A recognized, respected network — a lasting bridge between the French and Bangladeshi press.

about.valueBridgeBody: Fostering dialogue between the media and publics of both countries.
